what_this_lane_delivers.capability: A slip refusal that is about one leg is rendered at that leg's own row, associated by aria-describedby and keyed by leg id, so reordering the slip carries each message with the leg it names.
what_this_lane_delivers.what_it_deliberately_does_not_do: It adds no producer of a leg-scoped refusal that an operator can reach today. addLeg refuses to admit a leg that fails validation, so no committed leg can be incomplete through the UI. The rendering channel is built and proven; its first real producer is the per-leg refusals the parlay ticket API returns.
what_this_lane_delivers.why_that_split: Weakening addLeg to manufacture a reachable positive case would delete the entry-survival guarantee UTV2-1915 exists for, and a test-only hook would make the assertion about the hook rather than the product. The honest split is: prove the keying at the unit boundary, prove the negative half in the browser at both widths, and record the rest as owed.

browser_proof.defect_found_by_this_run: Two controls share data-testid="smart-form-submit-button" — the desktop panel button (hidden lg:flex) and the mobile sticky bar (lg:hidden). .first() selects by DOM order rather than visibility, so at 390px it resolved the hidden desktop control and the click timed out. The test now selects the :visible control. Before the fix: 1 failed, 3 passed.

known_gaps.disposition: addLeg refuses to admit a leg that fails validation, so a committed leg cannot become incomplete through the UI. Weakening that guard would delete UTV2-1915's entry-survival guarantee, and a test-only hook would make the assertion about the hook. The keying is proven at the unit boundary instead, and the real producer is the per-leg refusals the parlay ticket API returns (UTV2-1912's API third), for which legRefusalMessages is the rendering channel. Recorded rather than claimed.
